name: Obligation and filing calendar review
summary: Before each scheduled review, the compliance lead, company secretary or environmental lead sees what comes due from the organisation's own register: each obligation, filing and renewal with its owner, its due date as recorded, the evidence on file and every gap as a question. It works out no deadline and files nothing.

sources.title: FullyPowered AI's own design, written from its published map of three pieces of recurring work (the obligation register review, entity filing preparation and environmental monitoring evidence): the organisation's register as the only authority for what is owed and when, every gap turned into a question for a named role, and a person who files, submits, pays and updates the register.
